description:
Create, list, print, copy, delete and render notes. A note is named by its stem, the filename without .md (e.g. 2026-09-10-14-30-00), which is unique across the vault.

Subcommands:
  new --type TYPE --topic TOPIC --thread THREAD [--thread THREAD ...] [--person P ...] [--counterparty C] [--location L] — create a note; prints its path
  list [FILTER] [--json] — list every note, oldest first: stem, date, type, threads, topic
  cat STEM — print a note
  last — print the path of the newest note
  copy STEM — copy a note to a new timestamp; ' COPY' is appended to its topic
  delete STEM -y — permanently delete a note
  pdf STEM [--out DIR] — render to markdown and PDF (callouts and an action table); prints both paths
  minutes STEM [--out DIR] — render meeting minutes (agreements, resolutions, action items)
  agenda STEM [--out DIR] — render a meeting agenda (the note with its outcome sections emptied)

Args:
  STEM: note stem from `notes list`.
  FILTER: case-insensitive text matched against any column.

Flags:
  new:
    --type  required. One of Meeting, Correspondence, Workshop, Report, Log, Research, Recipe
    --topic TEXT  required, must not be empty
    --thread  required and repeatable. Accepts 'Kind/Name' or a wikilink. The note is filed under the first thread given
    --person NAME  Meeting and Correspondence only; repeatable. Linked when people/<Name>.md exists
    --counterparty TEXT  Meeting only
    --location TEXT  Meeting only
  list: --json  JSON output
  delete: -y / --yes  required to delete
  pdf, minutes, agenda: --out DIR  output directory (default: the user's Downloads folder). Writes <stem>.md and <stem>.md.pdf

Examples:
  ["new", "--type", "Meeting", "--topic", "Kickoff", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--person", "Sam Rivera", "--location", "Video call"]
  ["list", "northwind", "--json"]
  ["cat", "2026-09-10-14-30-00"]
  ["minutes", "2026-09-10-14-30-00", "--out", "out"]

Notes:
  Nothing prompts.
  Notes live at threads/<Kind>/<Name>/notes/<YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM-SS>.md.
  Every subcommand except `new` first ingests ACTION: lines into TASK: anchors, which rewrites note and log files in place.
  `new` queues a REF: in the buffer. It reaches the thread's daily log on `buffer flush`.
  delete is permanent and fails without -y.
  pdf, minutes and agenda need pandoc and a LaTeX engine.
  Exit 1: bad stem, no notes in the vault, empty --topic, --person on a type other than Meeting or Correspondence, --counterparty or --location on a non-Meeting note, or a failed PDF render.

BLOCKED: delete. These subcommands are refused and calling one returns an error. Do not attempt them.
